program.title: BSc in Ocean Science and Technology
uncertain: total_required_credits is a calculated value: the PDF does not state a fixed total for the major; it is the sum of the required_credits of all groups (using the lower bound for credit ranges such as 3-6, 0-3, 3-4, 2-4).

Several blocks allow alternative course choices (e.g. capstone block OCES 4964 / OCES 4974+4984 / SCIE 3500+4500, LIFS 1901 exemption, MATH block, PHYS block, LANG block), so the actual credits taken by a student may differ from the calculated total.
The elective list also allows 'Any OCES courses at 3000/4000-level' beyond the explicitly listed courses, so the recorded elective course list is not exhaustive.

The IRE Track and the two options (Marine Ecology, Oceanography) have additional requirements; options are optional ('Students may opt to graduate with or without an option'), and their credits are included in the calculated total.
Remarks in the PDF note that MATH 1012, OCES 2001, OCES 3201, OCES 3203 and OCES 4205 were last offered in earlier years and subsequently deleted; they are kept in the lists as printed in the PDF.

The PDF header/footer shows '2026-27 OST (4Y) (2023-24 intake)', i.e. the document is the 2023-24 intake curriculum rendered on a 2026-27 template; the year is recorded as 2023-24 per the intake year.
